result.summary: The home screen looks mostly polished. The only notable visual problem is the last restaurant card in the Fastest near you row being clipped on the right, including its title.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you carousel, the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol…) is cut off at the right edge, so the restaurant name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Give the last visible card more horizontal padding or allow the row to scroll so the full name remains readable without relying on a partial peek.
